You will contribute to setting engineering standards, optimise semantic models, and advance automation and reuse so our delivery teams move with pace and consistency. Do you thrive in fast paced, high-performing teams and enjoy mentoring others while improving the standard r on quality? Accountabilities: Solution Ownership: Lead the design, development, deployment, and support of secure, scalable, high-performing Power BI solutions that turn commercial and omnichannel data into actionable insight. Semantic Modelling and Performance: Build and optimise star-schema models, calculations, and DAX to deliver fast, reliable analytics at enterprise scale. Engineering Standards and Reuse: Define and promote standards, templates, and automation to increase consistency, reduce cycle time, and improve maintainability across reports and models. Data Quality and Governance: Ensure accuracy, accessibility, and actionability through rigorous source-to-report reconciliation, row-level security, lineage tracking, and regulated dissemination procedures. Stakeholder Partnership: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to business users, analysts, data engineers, governance teams, and delivery partners, translating objectives into technical designs with clear trade-offs. Mentoring and Reviews: Coach developers, lead design and code reviews, and cultivate a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Operational Excellence: Manage delivery workflows, gateways, and refresh strategies; diagnose and resolve issues related to reports, models, and security throughout the entire flow to keep solutions reliable. Agile Delivery: Estimate work, manage dependencies and risks, run UAT, and deliver several projects simultaneously in Agile or Scrum environments. Omnichannel Insight Enablement: Interpret campaign and channel metrics to generate insights that improve customer engagement and commercial impact across markets. Essential Skills/Experience: Bachelor’s Degree 4- 6 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, or data management, with at least 4years of hands-on Power BI solution delivery. Advanced proficiency in Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service, including semantic models, workspaces, apps, deployment pipelines, gateways, scheduled and incremental refresh, and row-level security. Expertise in DAX, Power Query, dimensional modelling, star schemas, calculation design, and performance optimisation for large or complex data models. Strong SQL skills and experience integrating data from relational databases, cloud data platforms, APIs, files, and enterprise applications. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot report, model, refresh, gateway, security, and data-quality issues across the end-to-end reporting flow. Experience with requirements elicitation, technical design, estimation, documentation, testing, source-to-report reconciliation, UAT, deployment, and production support. Understanding of enterprise data governance, information security, access controls, data lineage, quality management, and controlled release practices. Proven experience leading technical discussions, reviewing builds and code, mentoring developers, and influencing collaborators without direct authority. Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritisation, and communication skills, capable of explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Experience delivering multiple initiatives in parallel within Agile or Scrum teams, including risk management, dependency management, and continuous improvement. Knowledge of omnichannel, commercial, or digital marketing analytics and experience translating campaign and channel metrics into actionable insights. Desirable Skills/Experience: Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry, particularly commercial or omnichannel reporting. Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable cloud analytics platforms. Familiarity with DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, Performance Analyzer, source control, CI/CD, Power Automate, REST APIs, or scripting for administration and automation. Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) or a relevant Microsoft Fabric certification. Experience with Azure DevOps or Jira, Agile delivery, technical documentation, and structured knowledge transfer. It involves directing engineers in security best practices and maintaining the network's defense systems. The role plays a crucial part in protecting the Company's information systems. Job Description Job summary Independently performs standard network upgrades using approved automation tools and completes documented manual upgrades when tools fail, while troubleshooting common network and upgrade-related issues. Key roles and responsibilities Provide day-to-day operational support for routers and switches, including alert response, incident handling, service requests, and standard changes. Troubleshoot common interface, reachability, packet-loss, latency, hardware, and configuration issues. Own assigned tickets through diagnosis, remediation, validation, documentation, and closure within established priorities and escalation paths. Perform device health checks, configuration backup and restore, software and hardware inventory updates, and operational readiness checks. Review MOPs, prerequisites, image compatibility, device readiness, backups, and rollback requirements before execution. Execute standard upgrades through approved tools and validate each workflow stage and result. Perform manual network device upgrades using the approved MOP when the automation tool is unavailable, fails, or produces incomplete results. Troubleshoot common image transfer, boot variable, storage, reachability, protocol adjacency, interface, authentication, and post-upgrade validation issues. Make controlled decisions within the MOP, stop work when risk thresholds are reached, and escalate complex or service-impacting conditions. Execute rollback procedures and verify service restoration when upgrade acceptance criteria are not met. Coordinate with operations, engineering, application, monitoring, and change-management teams during maintenance activities. Document defects and improvement opportunities in upgrade tools and procedures. Preferred skills and experience Working knowledge of IPv4/IPv6, TCP/IP, MPLS, OSPF, BGP, and IS-IS. Hands-on experience with routers and switches from Cisco, Juniper, Arista, or Nokia. Experience with network OS upgrades, configuration backup/restore, monitoring, logs, and incident troubleshooting. Basic scripting or automation awareness is desirable. Education and certifications BE/B.Tech/M.Sc/MCA or equivalent technology qualification. Preferred certification: CCNA/CCNP, JNCIA/JNCIS Common behavioral attributes Clear written and verbal communication. Disciplined adherence to approved procedures and change controls. Collaborative, transparent, and accountable working style. Continuous learning and support for innovative technology. Ability to remain methodical during maintenance windows and service-impacting events. Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company. When you join Fuller, you’re joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business. If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it — Fuller is where that happens. About The Role The Machine Control Specialist (PLC Engineer) is a senior technical field leader responsible for driving complex installation, commissioning, Aftermarket Service, and optimization activities across heavy industrial process systems, with a strong focus on the cement industry . Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role serves as a trusted technical advisor to customers and internal stakeholders while directing multi-disciplinary field teams. The Machine Control Specialist combines deep Automation and Instrumentation expertise, specifically with Material Handling, heavy rotary and grinding equipment with site leadership, commercial awareness, and customer-facing problem-solving. This position plays a critical role in strengthening customer relationships, driving operational excellence during plant shutdowns, and generating service and spare parts business growth. This position will require Extensive travel to customer sites both planned and occasionally on short notice. About The Department Fuller Technologies Professional Service department is responsible to provide onsite support for it's Projects / aftermarket business in India. The primary responsibilities will be related to Installation, troubleshooting, technical leadership for Projects & Aftermarket Services of Fuller Technologies proprietary equipment. The Professional Service department works closely with Projects / After Market sales team. Your Responsibilities: Supervision of E&I installation/ testing/ commissioning activities at site. Coordination with customer, contractors. Vendor & HO. Maintain daily diary on site activities. Preparation of instruction sheets / advice notes to customer Preparation of weekly schedules & punch list jobs. Inspection of FLS supplied equipment /parts & reporting back to HO. Advising customer on site storage, equipment protection of FLS supplied equipment. Adhering to Customer safety rules and regulations. Ensure quality of job done by customer and contractor Preparation of MOMs with customer and vendors as and when required. Preparation of weekly reports, CAPA & Special reports and forward to HO Participation in Cold and Hot commissioning and preparation of reports with customer and contractor. Plant start-up, load trials & optimization Advice customer on plant operation & maintenance. Must have site experience on E&I installation and Commissioning activities PLC/DCS programming /testing /Commissioning for Siemens / Rockwell / ABB / Schneider Systems. Programming / testing of Intelligent MCCs. SCADA / HMI Programming / Testing. Site supervision for C&I and Control system equipment installation / Commissioning in Cement / Material Handling / Mineral Processing Industries. Experience in FLS - Automation ECS (V7 /V8) will be an added advantage. Industrials Protocols like Modbus, Ethernet, Profibus, Profinet, Device Net etc. Strong Technical Knowledge about, Field instruments and LV Electrical Equipment (LV Motors, MCC and PDBs) and FLS Standard to respective area Adequate expertise to trouble shooting. Focuses are both technical and leadership with execution targets (budgets). Interacts with technical personnel in the field and on the leadership level. Evaluates quality issues for the project, the machines and the system together. Manages support from headquarters to provide technical solutions. Identifies potential opportunities for Fuller Technologies products and services. Plans and organizes the job so that execution is on target (time). Advises customer and contractors on proper procedures and processes to guarantee technical specifications. You bring Bachelor's degree / Diploma in Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation Engineering 5 years of proven experience in cement / mining industry or other equipment / technology related. 3 years of proven experience in installation / commissioning / maintenance Leadership experience in project / aftermarket services for the cement / mining industries As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is. What We Offer Competitive remuneration package & access to salary packaging options to allow you to maximize your after-tax income. Competitive benefits package including Health Insurance, Personal Accident / Disability, Group Term Life Insurance, Annual health check-up, and voluntary insurance options. Work-life balance with a flexible work schedule so you can focus on professional and personal priorities. Time to recharge through 30 days PTO (with up to 10 days carry forward as Earned Leave stock) A global network of supportive colleagues and growth opportunities Continuous development and training in your area of expertise within a global Organization Application and contact Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible. No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please. Build a better world Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success. For further information on Fuller Technologies' business and services, visit https://www.fuller-technologies.com/

title: Lead Control Engineer
description: Job Description Summary Job Description Roles and Responsibilities As part of controls team responsible for project deliverables, controls software validation, project specific software creation, FAT, SAT, HIL, commissioning support for Solar & Battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. Work across the Hybrid engineering and services organizations to prepare documentation for installation, commissioning, and operations for use by internal GE employees and our customers. Work on design, develop and deploy the control hardware configuration for each project and design the communication network, including but not limited to DI/DO, Ethernet, FO and other industrial communication etc. Support problem identification and resolution of new and installed products. Work on standardization of controls project execution, software validation, implementation. Experience in various countries grid code compliance particularly Australian grid code, PLQ & AEMO requirements, UK, USA, European, Germany, Itali, Turkey & India grid codes. Familiar with AS/NZS safety standards. Worked in any power generation industry like BESS, solar. renewable, thermal, nuclear etc. Experience in communication networks equipment’s functionality, Selection, Software features, Hardware & Cyber security. Demonstrated implementation of controls or systems integration in products and field engineering experience. Desired Characteristics Ability to summarize and communicate complex technical information Strong problem analysis and resolution skills Curiosity, passion for excellence, drive to deliver on time Knowledge of power conversion systems and controls. Present technical plans in voice of customer Experience in working cross-functionally between Engineering, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Logistics, Product Management, etc. Self-started attitude is strongly requested Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills Mentor & Guide team Self-Starter, demonstrate ability to work effectively within and between teams and as Individual Ability to energize teams and perceives change as an opportunity Ability to work effectively in a culturally diverse and highly matrix environment. The candidate will be responsible for designing and scaling automation frameworks, integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, and leading a team of automation engineers to improve test coverage, quality, and execution efficiency. Develop reusable, maintainable, and modular test cases and automation components. Establish coding standards, review automation scripts, and promote automation best practices. Implement Tosca-based automation solutions for enterprise applications. 2. Test Automation & Functional Validation Translate business requirements into executable test scenarios and test cases. Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing. Validate application workflows, integrations, reports, and user roles. Support release validation, patch testing, and regression cycles. 3. CI/CD Integration Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions. Configure parallel execution, scheduled runs, and headless testing where applicable. Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot failures, and implement quality gates and test reporting dashboards. 4. Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals. Knowledge of accessibility and security testing. Understanding of performance testing fundamentals and test execution optimization. Preferred Candidate Profile Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Proven ability to improve automation coverage, framework reusability, and test execution efficiency.

title: Senior or Lead Automation Engineer -Energy Chennai
description: Company Description Ramboll in India With over 1,000 experts across five offices in India, Ramboll delivers innovative solutions across diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people-first organization committed to creating sustainable impact through collaboration and innovation. Inviting bright minds Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative and empowering culture? We work to create a sustainable future and our inspiring projects and innovative solutions aim to set the standard among our peers. You will join a global company that has been growing successfully since its founding in 1945. Together, we lead and leave a positive impact on societies, companies and people around the world. You will join our Automation and Communication department As the SCADA or Automation Senior, you are part of an exceptional technical environment with passionate colleagues in Denmark and Chennai. The department is highly experienced and delivers engineering and consultancy services globally within the energy sector for projects around the world. We are seeking a senior engineer to lead vendor-independent automation solutions across multiple industries—including low‑carbon and green industry projects such as carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS) and Power‑to‑X (PtX)—covering the full lifecycle from concept to handover. The role spans Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), Distributed Control System (DCS), Programmable Logic Controller (PLC), Operational Technology (OT) networking, and multi-system integration (Electrical, Fire and Gas, Telecom, Power Management) with hands-on exposure to major Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) platforms (e.g., Siemens, ABB, Emerson DeltaV, Yokogawa) while maintaining platform independence. Strong experience with data‑centric delivery using AVEVA Engineering is required Job Description Technical leadership and delivery Lead automation strategy, architecture, and design across all phases: early concept, feasibility, Pre‑Front‑End Engineering Design (Pre‑FEED), Front‑End Engineering Design (FEED), detailed FEED, detailed engineering, Factory Acceptance Test (FAT), integrated Factory Acceptance Test (iFAT), Site Acceptance Test (SAT). Produce key specifications and deliverables: User Requirements Specification (URS), Basis of Design (BOD), control philosophy, alarm philosophy aligned to International Society of Automation (ISA) 18.2 and Engineering Equipment and Materials Users Association (EEMUA) 191, Safety Requirements Specification (SRS) for Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), Functional Design Specification (FDS), Software Design Specification (SDS), Cause and Effect (C&E) matrices, Input/Output (I/O) lists, instrument index, interface specifications, and test plans. Develop SCADA/DCS/PLC architectures, OT network topologies, and cybersecurity controls; define Operational Technology/Information Technology (OT/IT) demarcation and data flows. Guide technology selection with vendor‑agnostic trade‑off analyses; prepare Requests for Quotation (RFQs), conduct technical bid evaluations, and manage vendor clarifications and deviations. Oversee panel and hardware design, I/O allocation, wiring topologies, segregation and Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC), power and Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) sizing, and hazardous area compliance. Multi-system design, interfaces, and integration Fire and Gas System (FGS), Emergency Shutdown (ESD): Fire and Gas mapping, detector layout, voting logic (e.g., one‑out‑of‑two [1oo2], two‑out‑of‑three [2oo3]), shutdown hierarchy, bypass/override management, proof‑testing, and integration with process control and safety systems. Electrical and power: integration of Motor Control Centers (MCCs), Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), soft starters, generator controls, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), switchgear, Direct Current (DC) and UPS systems, Electrical Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (eSCADA). Power Management System (PMS) and Energy Management System (EMS): load shedding, load sharing, black start, islanding, synchronization, and power quality. Substation Automation System (SAS) and protection: Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs) and relays, International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) 61850 communications (Manufacturing Message Specification [MMS], Generic Object Oriented Substation Event [GOOSE], and Sampled Values [SV]). Smart relays and micro‑PLC devices: local logic, packaged equipment controls, and maintainable documentation. Telecom systems: Public Address and General Alarm (PAGA), Closed‑Circuit Television (CCTV), access control, time services via Network Time Protocol (NTP)/Precision Time Protocol (PTP) with Global Positioning System (GPS) clocks, radio (Ultra High Frequency [UHF]/Very High Frequency [VHF]), microwave, fiber, and enterprise voice (Private Automatic Branch Exchange [PABX]/Internet Protocol [IP] telephony); alignment with Network Management Systems (NMS) and Quality of Service (QoS). Interfaces and protocols: Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture (OPC UA), Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT), Modbus Transmission Control Protocol (Modbus TCP)/Modbus Remote Terminal Unit (Modbus RTU), EtherNet Industrial Protocol (EtherNet/IP), Process Field Network (PROFINET), Process Field Bus (PROFIBUS), Distributed Network Protocol 3 (DNP3), IEC 60870‑5‑104, IEC 61850. Architecture, redundancy, and safety integrity High‑availability platforms: controller/server redundancy (hot/warm standby), historian clustering, failover Human–Machine Interface (HMI) servers, redundant I/O and storage. Triple Modular Redundant (TMR) and high‑integrity systems: specify, engineer, and test TMR safety platforms and high‑availability DCS/PLC architectures; implement voting logic (e.g., 2oo3, 2oo4). Safety Integrity Level (SIL) engineering: lead SIL determination and verification, design Safety Instrumented Functions (SIFs), calculate Average Probability of Failure on Demand (PFDavg), specify proof‑test intervals, align with IEC 61511/IEC 61508. Network resilience: segmented Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), demilitarized zones (DMZs), firewalls, and redundancy using Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol (RSTP), Parallel Redundancy Protocol (PRP), and High‑availability Seamless Redundancy (HSR). Functional safety and cybersecurity Apply IEC 61511/IEC 61508 across the safety lifecycle; lead Hazard and Operability Studies (HAZOP), Hazard Identification (HAZID), Layer of Protection Analysis (LOPA), SIL determination/verification, and SRS development. Implement IEC 62443 cybersecurity controls; conduct risk assessments, zoning, compliance testing, including verification during FAT/iFAT/SAT. Data‑centric and digital delivery (AVEVA Engineering) Deliver projects using AVEVA Engineering for data‑centric execution: class libraries, tag governance, specifications, datasheets, and cross‑discipline registers (instruments, I/O, cables, equipment). Configure digital thread integrations between AVEVA Engineering, Computer‑Aided Design (CAD) and Computer‑Aided Engineering (CAE) tools (e.g., EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical), historians (e.g., AVEVA/OSIsoft Plant Information [PI] System), and document control; drive quality through single‑source‑of‑truth. Establish model‑based standards, templates, and rules for automatic deliverable generation and change control. Client engagement and project management Define scope, schedule, budget, resource plans, and risk registers; manage change and ensure Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC). Lead design workshops, vendor meetings, and multi‑discipline coordination; mentor junior engineers; perform technical reviews. Dedicated Capabilities For FAT, IFAT, And SAT Strategy and planning Define verification strategy, acceptance criteria, and traceability from URS/BOD through FDS/SDS to test protocols, including process, safety (SIS/ESD/FGS/HIPPS), electrical/PMS/SAS, telecom, and cybersecurity controls. Environment preparation Build test environments with virtualized controllers and HMIs, simulators, hardware‑in‑the‑loop, and representative OT networks (VLANs, firewalls, NTP/PTP, RSTP/PRP/HSR). Execution Lead or witness FAT at vendor facilities, integrated FAT with third‑party packages, and SAT onsite, including: FGS/ESD/HIPPS: detector/logic testing, voting, trip propagation, bypass management, cause‑and‑effect validation, proof‑tests. Electrical/PMS/SAS: relay schemes, IEC 61850 MMS/GOOSE messaging, load shedding/restoration, synchronization/islanding/black start, MCC/VFD and breaker interlocks. Telecom: PAGA priorities, alarm routing, CCTV integration, time synchronization, network failover. Control systems: redundancy and failover (controllers/servers/I/O), sequence/batch verification (ISA‑88), alarm management (ISA 18.2), historian/reporting integrity, data quality. Safety, cybersecurity, and closure Execute proof testing for SIS/ESD/FGS; verify SIL targets; perform cybersecurity hardening checks (IEC 62443); manage non‑conformances and punch lists; produce test records, redlines, as‑built updates, and Operations and Maintenance (O&M) training materials; facilitate client sign‑off. Green industries and decarbonization domain expertise Carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS) Control and safety for amine‑based and alternative solvent absorbers/strippers, reboilers, solvent reclaiming, carbon dioxide (CO2) compression, dehydration, and pipeline or sequestration interfaces. Anti‑surge and performance control for compressors; leak detection and emergency shutdown integration; emissions monitoring and Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV) considerations. Power‑to‑X (PtX) and hydrogen Control strategies for electrolyzers (Proton Exchange Membrane [PEM] and alkaline), Balance of Plant (BOP) systems (deionized water, hydrogen purification, nitrogen purge, cooling), storage and pressure control, and blending. Downstream synthesis controls and interlocks: green ammonia (NH3), methanol (MeOH), synthetic fuels including Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) and e‑fuels; batch/sequence control (ISA‑88) where applicable. Renewable and efficient energy systems Integration with renewable generation and microgrids: wind, solar Photovoltaic (PV), Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), heat pumps, district heating/cooling, and waste‑heat recovery; coordination via PMS/EMS and SCADA. Safety and compliance for green projects Hydrogen and oxygen hazard management, hazardous area classification (e.g., explosive atmospheres [ATEX]), relevant National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) and American Petroleum Institute (API) practices; SIL application to hydrogen/oxygen service.
